Long dark textured hair, threaded with a few subtle braids and tiny metallic details, carries residual motion around her shoulders. She looks just past the lens with focused, self-possessed intensity. Tall carved arches and weathered stone columns recede behind her into warm shadow. Golden late-afternoon light enters from one side, grazing her skin, embroidery, jewelry, and moving fabric while the hall falls progressively darker behind her.
